column1: # assets/data-sources.tsv: every file setup downloads, one row each (or one
# per family of files). og setup fetch, og setup plan and og setup prune read
# id          the source's name (og setup fetch --source ID, og setup prune ID)
# installers  setup (a plain setup) or the setup.sh flags without their dashes
#             that download it; og setup plan --for picks rows by them
# steps       the steps that read it
# path        where it is kept: downloads/... is the downloads folder
#             setup keeps after installing it (og setup prune deletes those);
#             anything else is a file setup installs under GENOME_DIR. A path
#             ending in / is a folder of many files.
# parts       a family's members, {part} in the path and URL (A..B: A to B)
# url         where it comes from; - when the installer builds the URL
# check       md5, sha256, sum (BSD, Ensembl's CHECKSUMS), gzip-ends, crc32c,
#             or empty (a whole gzip file, else not empty)
# value       the pinned checksum, a checksum list's URL, @ID (the list row
#             ID stores), or - when the installer reads it (a manifest)
# bytes       its size as the server gave it (HEAD or a GET, 2026-11-26), the sum of
#             its parts for a family; aadr is the release's own figure; empty
# licence     the terms the data comes with (the notices setup prints)
# ${NAME} is a pin of versions.env and ${NAME:-default} an environment
# variable. A pin written out here (revel, alphamissense) lives only here:
# tests/fetch.rs of og-setup fails when it is also in versions.env,
